facts.fact: The DIAL expert comment states that Morocco's 2015 adequacy list, a list of countries personal data may be sent to, did not recognise a single African country; the year is the only date given.

note: Regional article; only the Morocco adequacy-list sentence concerns this country.
Compares two continental data-exchange platforms and a pilot in Morocco; states nothing on a rule for sending data out of the country.

slug: 2025-07-14 Smart Africa co-creates Africa's first Cross-Border Data Exchange Guidelines (Rabat, ADD-chaired CAITA)
note: A regional guideline being drafted at a meeting in Rabat; not a Moroccan rule on sending data abroad.
Facial-recognition moratorium; says nothing on sending data abroad.

facts.fact: The Council of Europe Consultative Committee states that Moroccan law 09-08 (articles 43 and 44) lays down protection of transfers of personal data to foreign countries, in particular where the country does not provide an adequate level of protection; dated 18 October 2012, the document does not give the law's date.

note: The document describes customs-to-customs electronic information exchange under the Agadir Agreement, not a rule on sending personal data abroad.
The document states nothing on Morocco's rule on sending data abroad.
Lists a transfer abroad only as a processing line in a case; states no transfer rule.
